node.statement: For each i,j, apply def-ha-map with Z=Z_ij, X=X_j, and Y=Y_i. Its exact defining display, with its original normalization notation, is (Y_i^dagger dot Z_ij) dot X_j + Y_i^dagger dot (Z_ij dot X_j) = 2*<Y_i,Ha^Q_{P,R}(Z_ij)(X_j)>*wt(Q), where wt(Q)=Co_Q(Q). Equivalently, reversing the equality, 2*<Y_i,Ha^Q_{P,R}(Z_ij)(X_j)>*wt(Q)=(Y_i^dagger dot Z_ij) dot X_j+Y_i^dagger dot (Z_ij dot X_j).
